title: Caro-Kann Defense: Karpov Variation
line: A knight comes out first to back up the other one, and Black steps around a famous mate.

steps.text: In the Caro-Kann main line, Black took on e4 and White's knight took back.
Bring the knight to d7. It gets ready to back up your other knight.

also.c8f5: That is the Classical Variation, another main line. This lesson goes on with the knight.
also.g8f6: That also works. This lesson goes on with the knight on d7.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out. It challenges White's knight, and the knight on d7 backs it up.

also.e7f6: That works too, though it changes your pawns. This lesson takes with the knight.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out. It pins White's knight to the queen.
A famous trap: here White's queen came to e2. If your other knight comes out to f6, White's knight jumps to d6 and it is mate.
So bring the knight on d7 to f6 instead. It hits White's knight, and your king keeps d7 free.

wrong.g8f6: That walks into it: White's knight jumps to d6, and it is mate.

summary: The knight comes out first to back up the other, and Black keeps a square free for the king against the queen trap.
